_comment: SHA-256 hashes of bundled model files. Add an entry per model after retraining; rf_preprocessing.load_model_safely() rejects unknown hashes unless verify_hash=False is passed explicitly. The bundled RF model ships in skops format (version-tolerant, no arbitrary-code deserialization); regenerate with scripts/convert_model_to_skops.py or scripts/retrain_rf_model.py.
